messages:
Alex K: Morning handoff — quick sync.
Alex K: Active incident: PD-2376 (embed-kvcache-increase). Observed CPU spikes on runtime nodes during nightly batches, causing P95 token latency to climb ~200ms.
Maya G: saw the spike in dashboards. I applied a temporary autoscaler tweak to add one extra replica on QPS surge. Monitoring now.
Alex K: Mitigation applied: limited background batch concurrency to 40% (airflow job nightly-run-2). This is temporary; need a more robust fix.
Samir P: FYI PR #5423 modifies the autoscaler to ignore background-ci label. Requesting review from eng-runtime.
Leo T: I'll review PR #5423 in ~1h. Quick glance looks small.
Zara: Pager update: PD-2376 auto-resolved at 10:12 UTC but degraded latency signals persist at low volume. I re-opened the incident for tracking.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty PD-2376 acknowledged by Maya G — https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-2376
Alex K: Commands run during mitigation:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep redwood-runtime
kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-runtime -n prod
```
Maya G: After throttle the p95 is down to +30ms (from +200ms). Still keeping alerts on for 2 hours.
Samir P: Blocker: can't reproduce locally because the issue seems tied to scaled batch concurrency. @Zara can you attach the airflow task logs?
Zara: Uploaded logs to S3: s3://redwood-ops/logs/airflow/nightly-run-2/2026-11-05.log
Alex K: Next steps: Leo to review and merge PR, Maya to keep monitoring for 2h, Samir to run a targeted RCA job against the uploaded logs, Zara to update incident timeline and close PD when stable. I'll update the runbook with the temporary throttle steps.
Leo T: Noted. Also saw slight node-label drift affecting the autoscaler selector; filing infra task TICKET-1198.
Leo T: Filed infra task: TICKET-1198 — infra team to normalize labels and add a unit test to prevent drift.
Alex K: Thanks team. Taking handoff off the bridge — Leo, you're on for the next 2 hours. :coffee:
Leo T: Taking over. Ping me for any pagers or if latency reappears.
